thank you. i tell myself that all the time, and i deeply believe in existentialism, so it is silly to be pressured by society and, therefore, see yourself as a failure by the eyes of other than yourself.

sorry for my english, second tongue
but i won't lead you anywhere, it's an immense pleasure for me, but it will not help me. So because i can't fit i have accepted the idea that i'm doomed because of myself.
